settings.invalid_name: Not a valid name. It must not be empty or contain / \ : * ? " < > |
about.title: About ReefHue
about.tagline: Colour correction for underwater photos and videos.
about.credits: Built with Qt for Python (PySide6, LGPL), NumPy, OpenCV, Pillow, piexif, PyAV and Send2Trash. FFmpeg is supplied by you and not part of ReefHue.

shift.jump_detected: The camera clock seems to have jumped (e.g. reset after a battery change). The selection can be split into {count} groups, each with its own anchor.

ffmpeg.dialog.help_missing_encoders: This FFmpeg lacks the encoders {encoders}. Video export is not available until you use an FFmpeg that includes x264 and x265 (Homebrew's build or a complete static build). Photo editing and video playback keep working.

export.title: Export
export.intro: Export {count} file(s): {photos} photo(s), {videos} video(s). Your originals stay untouched unless you choose “Overwrite original”.
export.overwrite_note: The original is moved to the Trash and replaced by the edited version. The edit is then reset, because it is now part of the file.
export.videos_unavailable: Videos cannot be exported: FFmpeg or its x264/x265 encoders are missing (see Help ▸ FFmpeg help). Photos are exported.
export.overwrite_confirm: {count} original file(s) will be moved to the Trash and replaced by the edited versions. You can restore them from the Trash.
export.conflict_apply_all: Do this for all remaining conflicts
export.error.read_only: This folder is open read-only (see the note above the file list), so nothing can be exported into it.
export.error.write: the file could not be written
export.error.verify: the result could not be verified
export.note.telemetry_dropped: GoPro telemetry could not be kept
queue.title: Export queue
queue.quit_confirm: Exports are still running. Cancel them and quit? Unfinished files are removed; your originals are not touched.
editor.magic_tip: Analyse the picture and set depth, colour balance and levels automatically. All values stay editable.
editor.magic_current_frame_tip: Off: several frames across the clip (or segment) are analysed together.
editor.lut_invalid: This file is not a valid .cube LUT: {detail}
editor.lut_missing: The LUT “{name}” is missing. It is ignored until you put it back into the LUT folder.
editor.lut_changed: The LUT “{name}” has changed since it was chosen. The current file is used.
error.folder_no_access: ReefHue is not allowed to read the folder “{path}”. On a Mac, allow access in System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security ▸ Files and Folders (or Full Disk Access) and open the folder again.
error.folder_open: The folder “{path}” could not be opened. Details are in the log file (Help ▸ Open log folder).
sidecar.warn.read_only_folder: This folder is write-protected. You can view the files and try out settings, but nothing is saved and nothing can be exported here.
param.underwater.auto_strength.tip: How strongly the underwater correction (depth and auto result) is applied. 0 % = off.
param.underwater.depth_m.tip: Approximate depth of the subject. Water absorbs red first, so a larger depth brings back more red. 0 = no depth correction.
param.underwater.water_type.tip: Kind of water: decides how much red, green and blue the depth correction restores.
param.underwater.red_comp.tip: Fine-tunes the red channel on top of the depth correction.
param.white_balance.tint.tip: Green to magenta. Underwater pictures often need a little magenta.
param.light.contrast.tip: Difference between light and dark areas.
param.light.highlights.tip: Brightness of the bright areas. Lower it to recover detail in the surface or sunlit sand.
param.light.shadows.tip: Brightness of the dark areas, e.g. under overhangs.
param.light.whites.tip: Sets the brightest tones (white clipping point).
param.light.blacks.tip: Sets the darkest tones (black clipping point).
param.color.vibrance.tip: Boosts weak colours more than strong ones – gentler than saturation.
param.levels.black.tip: Input value that becomes black. Raise it to remove a milky haze.
param.levels.white.tip: Input value that becomes white. Lower it to brighten the image.
param.details.dehaze.tip: Removes the haze caused by particles in the water. Negative values add haze.
param.details.clarity.tip: Local contrast in the mid-tones: makes textures such as coral stand out.
param.details.sharpen_amount.tip: Strength of the sharpening. Judge it in the 100 % view.
param.details.sharpen_radius.tip: Size of the details that are sharpened, in pixels.
param.details.denoise.tip: Reduces grain and colour noise, e.g. in deep or dark shots.
param.geometry.vignette_corr.tip: Brightens dark corners caused by the lens or housing.
param.geometry.straighten_deg.tip: Rotates the image to level the horizon. The image is cropped so no empty corners appear.
param.geometry.rotate_90.tip: Rotates by 90° steps (R / Shift+R in the preview).
param.lut.intensity.tip: How strongly the LUT is blended in.
param.lut.position.tip: Last: a creative look on top of your corrections. First: a technical LUT that converts Flat/Log footage before everything else.
editor.slider_hint: Double-click to reset · arrow keys or +/−: step (Shift ×10, Alt/Option ×0.1)
editor.magic_selection_tip: Run the automatic analysis separately for every selected file.
editor.auto_tip: Suggest exposure and contrast from the histogram.
editor.auto_wb_tip: Neutralise the remaining colour cast (temperature and tint).
editor.crop_reset_tip: Remove the crop and the aspect ratio.
editor.lut_import_tip: Copy a .cube file into ReefHue's LUT folder.
editor.lut_folder_tip: Open the LUT folder in Finder / Explorer.
editor.lut_combo_tip: Colour look-up table (.cube) applied to this file.
presets.apply_tip: Apply the selected preset to the selected files; you choose which sections.
presets.save_tip: Save the settings of the current file as a new preset.
presets.delete_tip: Delete the selected preset (built-in presets cannot be deleted).
editor.reset_tab_tip: Reset all settings on this tab to their defaults.
editor.curve_channel_tip: Curve to edit: overall brightness or a single colour channel.
editor.curve_enabled_tip: Switch this curve on or off without losing its points.
editor.curve_preset_tip: Replace the curve with a ready-made shape.
editor.level_channel_tip: Levels for all channels together or for one colour channel.
editor.aspect_tip: Aspect ratio of the crop frame.
files.include_subfolders_tip: Also list photos and videos in subfolders.
files.hide_exported_tip: Hide the edited copies and snapshots that ReefHue has written.
files.type_filter_tip: Show only photos or only videos.
files.status_filter_tip: Show only files with this editing/export status.
files.search_tip: Filter the list by file name.
video.segment_only_tip: Play only the part between the start and end handles.
video.loop_tip: Start again from the beginning at the end.

queue.cancel_all_tip: Cancel all waiting and running exports. Partly written files are removed.
queue.copy_log_tip: Copy the details of failed exports to the clipboard.
queue.clear_tip: Remove finished exports from the list.
about.ffmpeg_missing: not found – video features are off
about.copy_info_tip: Copy these details to the clipboard, e.g. for a bug report.
